no_op_rationale: equipment.py contains EXCLUSIVELY update_one calls on pre-existing documents (no insert_one, no upsert=True). The ensure_server_scope helper is designed for insert/upsert write surfaces (with $setOnInsert semantics for new documents). Applying it to update_one on existing docs would either be a no-op (if used with $setOnInsert without upsert) OR an inline DB migration (if used with $set), which is explicitly forbidden by PROMPT §4: 'do not migrate existing DB docs in this task'. All user_equipment document CREATION happens in combat.py (Batch-4 future) and raids.py (out-of-scope), not in equipment.py.
